resources.string:
Unfret looks at a shop page, an ad or a service provider's page and tells you in plain words what the risks are, and why.

• Share a link to Unfret from any app, or paste it here. The page opens inside Unfret, on your phone, over your own connection, so you can accept a cookie banner or solve a captcha.

• Nothing is read until you tap Check this page. Then Unfret reads the page on your phone: the product facts and the visible text. Account menus, greetings, forms, checkout and delivery areas, and any address that isn't the business's own are removed first. On a private seller's ad, the seller's name is never read.

• Only those facts, that text and the page address are sent, to unfret.net. Nothing about you or your phone: no account, no pass, no device ID.

• Checks are free. Before a deep check your phone solves a small puzzle, which keeps free checks fair.

• The app keeps nothing about the pages you check. Their cookies and cache are deleted when you close them.
Paste a product or ad link
Or share a link to Unfret from your browser or a marketplace app.
Checks are free. No account, no pass.
When Unfret gets a page wrong, tap Wrong result? under the result. A report keeps the page it\'s about, never who sent it.

A random key made on this phone and sent only with your reports, never with a check. Reports with a key count for more, and you can put a name of your choosing on the leaderboard. If you lose the key, you start a new profile.
Unfret forgets your profile and this phone deletes the key. Your reports stay, without it.
